text: Severity-1 (Sev-1) outage SLA: 15-minute initial response, 4-hour resolution target.
Refund policy: full refund available within 30 days of initial subscription.
Goodwill credits: may be applied up to $200 per incident for platform-caused outages.
Refund exceptions: enterprise contracts have custom refund terms defined in the MSA.
POST /v2/analytics accepts JSON body with query, filters, pagination. Rate limit: 60 requests/second.
GET /v2/customers/{id} returns customer profile including tier, status, CSM assignment.
Auth: all endpoints require Bearer token via Authorization header.
Q3 compliance: customer PII must remain in-region (EU customers in eu-west-1).
SOC 2 Type 2 report: available on request via compliance portal.
Data retention: 90 days default; enterprise contracts can extend to 2 years.
